t: Mikesell's Snack Food Company | LinkedIn
s: Headquartered in Dayton, Ohio since 1910, Mikesell’s Snack Food Company manufactures and/or distributes snack foods such as potato chips, pretzels, puffcorn, popcorn, cheese curls and pork rinds in Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky and Central Illinois. It has manufacturing plants in Dayton and Indianapolis and distribution centers in Dayton, OH, Indianapolis, IN and Louisville, KY.
